meta.title: Two bids: award only 6 of the 10 units to B (partial award); no approval flow
gaps: A closed RFQ with two vendors and two bids priced A 100 and B 90; the prepared state contains exactly one vendor and one bid.
Entering a partial allocation of 6 units to Vendor B and leaving 4 units un-awarded; no catalog step accepts per-vendor allocation quantities.
Verifying Vendor B's exact calculation of 6 × 90 = 540 and the remaining 4 un-awarded units.
Verifying that no approval flow occurs and that the split award creates the requested vendor-specific PO and History result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A closed RFQ with two vendors and two bids priced A 100 and B 90; the prepared state contains exactly one vendor and one bid.; Entering a partial allocation of 6 units to Vendor B and leaving 4 units un-awarded; no catalog step accepts per-vendor allocation quantities.; Verifying Awarded Vendors reads 1/2.; Verifying Vendor B's exact calculation of 6 × 90 = 540 and the remaining 4 un-awarded units.; Verifying that no approval flow occurs and that the split award creates the requested vendor-specific PO and History result.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for prepared-state tests.
Exercise the supported closed-event award flow with the single available bid; this submits the award proposal but cannot perform the requested partial allocation.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Exercise the closest supported downstream PO creation flow after the award.
Assert that the created purchase order carries the awarded event line item and quantity.
